# Lemmy.World

> > A federated social discussion platform hosting diverse communities covering politics, technology, culture, entertainment, and mutual support.

Lemmy.World is a major instance in the Lemmy federated network, featuring community-driven discussions across topics from Swiss news and political commentary to gaming updates, sobriety support, and cultural criticism. Content includes cross-posts from sources like NZZ, The Guardian, and original community discussions.

## Key Topics

- Federated social platform
- Community discussions
- Political commentary and cartoons
- Swiss news (NZZ)
- Social behavior analysis
- Work-life balance
- Technology and gaming
- Book and media reviews
- Sobriety and recovery support
- Data visualization critique
- Cultural criticism
- International politics
- Entertainment and music
- Environmental conservation

## Community Support & Wellness

- [The Daily Check-In for Friday March 13th, Just for Today - We are NOT Drinking!](https://lemmy.world/post/44194795): Daily sobriety pledge and community support for alcohol recovery
- [Welcome to c/dentistry — an open, uncensored alternative to r/dentistry](https://lemmy.world/post/44185016): Community announcement for uncensored dentistry discussion forum
- [Rich with Relaxation Time/You Time?](https://lemmy.world/post/44186052): Community discussion on work-life balance and personal time management

- [Protestation](https://lemmy.world/post/44184271): Cross-posted Palestine political activism and protest content
